snippet.title: [Release Date Trailer] Retro Sci-Fi Survival Adventure Before Fate will launch on April 14th!
snippet.description:
Dear Researchers,

The final timeline has been set.

Before Fate will officially launch on April 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM (UTC+8).

Before Fate is a retro sci-fi survival RPG.
Amid a constantly collapsing timeline, you will explore anomalous zones, gather resources, and uncover the hidden truth.

In the days leading up to launch, we’ll be sharing more about the game’s core structure and final trailer.

If this timeline interests you, please add Before Fate to your Steam Wishlist now！
